profile.summary: A California company based in Oakland that provides hazardous-material cleanup and related construction services. Its work includes removing asbestos and lead, cleaning up contaminated soil, handling mold and other biohazards, responding to emergencies, and demolition. It is part of the Bayview Services group of companies.
